successfulCiBeforeRejection.authorityBoundary: Run-level fields, exact attempt, job, and artifact metadata were observed through GitHub APIs. Mutable pull_requests[] relationship fields are not historical authority. CI success is recorded as an observation, not as completion approval.

postCiAudit.source: Codex collaboration sub-agent response recorded by the primary agent
materialBlockers: The external artifact verifier trusted caller-authored provider inspection JSON, so the supposedly independent C3/main artifact judgment could be self-reported.
No workflow on the default branch independently downloaded and verified both the exact C3 pull-request artifact and the merged-main push artifact before completion reporting.
The Round 4 Acceptance did not freeze and enforce the exact C1 changed-path and addition/modification set, so unrelated files could be mixed into C1.
The merged main result was not bound as an exact two-parent [pre-merge main,C3] commit whose event-time PR base and push.before both equal the first parent.
Because the weak C1 and its successful CI were already published, amending or force-replacing it would erase a failed review round and violate the required learn-and-rebuild loop.

requiredChanges: replace caller-authored inspection input with direct attempt-scoped GitHub API access inside the verifier
add and freeze a default-branch workflow_run audit for exact C3 and main artifacts
freeze and verify the exact Round 5 C1 changed-path and A/M set
bind merged main to the exact two-parent [pre-merge main,C3] topology, matching the C3 base and push.before values
